title: Spouse Transition & Readiness Seminar (STARS)
intro:
Military Transition: The Spouse Edition

This seminar was created to empower YOU as a military spouse and provide resources to assist in making plans for your future and prepare for life beyond the military.

sections.markdown:
Spouses, this is your chance to ask the experts questions on important topics prior to your Marine or Sailor retiring or separating from active duty service.

Workshop: 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. with a 30-minute lunch

NOTE: There is a refrigerator and microwave available for use and please know you are welcome to bring food.

For questions, please contact: smb_mccsquanticofmeap@usmc.mil
